title: The Agentic Economy Is WAY Bigger Than You Think | Xen Baynham-Herd
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine The Agentic Economy Is WAY Bigger Than You Think | Xen Baynham-Herd Tokenized stocks on Base grabbed about a third of weekly spot trading in their market just months after launch, and Xen Baynham-Herd, Director of Marketing and Global Expansion at Base, says that's only the start. This post The Agentic Economy Is WAY Bigger Than You Think | Xen Baynham-Herd first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
